doc.title: Flip Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996

title: Jerry Dodgion and the I-W-S tour with Benny Goodman
summary: Prompted by Jerry Dodgion, Mr. Rowe asks about I-W-S, which Phillips explains as "I Won't Snap" during his time touring with Goodman.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: You spent a little time touring with Benny Goodman too.
I’m watching the time too, we’ll wrap up here pretty quick.
Yeah. I saw — I didn’t see him he called me before I came here. He’s quite a player, Jerry.
Nice guy. He told me to ask you about something. The I-W-S Tour. He made me promise I’d ask.
You want to talk about that for a moment?
